statement: The two evaluation regimes are not interchangeable, so replication of the context-supervision effect under standard-benchmark methodology is untested rather than likely or unlikely. The closest work's metric is four-way answer selection over synthetically generated options whose hop depth is controlled by construction, on KGs built for the purpose; the standard regime is Hits@1 entity ranking on naturally occurring questions over Freebase with no passage provenance. A selection-accuracy gain among four generated options need not appear in Hits@1 ranking, and the standard benchmarks cannot host the mechanism at all because their triples are not traceable to source passages; conversely, the standard regime's deepest standard tier is 3 hops, whereas the idea's claim is specifically about 3-5 hops. The appropriate methodology for the refined question is therefore per-hop accuracy on a frozen split plus open-ended exact match/F1 on a text-attributed corpus, retaining multiple choice only for comparability with the published number.
